unconfirmedHelp: Some devices haven’t confirmed receipt. This send won’t be retried automatically.
manualOnly: Images and files are sent manually.
noDirectory: The system download directory could not be found. Choose a receive directory.
directoryHelp: Defaults to Nooboard in your system download directory, created on first receipt. Images and files are saved before updating the clipboard. Changes apply to new transfers.
emptyHelp: Send an image or files from the clipboard, or choose files above.
errorDenied: The device is not accepting transfers.
errorDirectory: Choose a writable receive directory on the receiving device.
errorUnsupported: This content type is not supported.
errorTooLarge: The transfer exceeds the size or item limit.
errorSourceChanged: The source changed. Select or copy it again.
errorIntegrity: The received size or checksum does not match.
errorIo: The file could not be read or saved. Check permissions and free space.
errorClipboard: Files are saved on the receiving device. Copy them again there to update its clipboard.
errorOffline: The device disconnected or is unavailable.
errorTimeout: The transfer stopped making progress or its result was not confirmed.
errorBusy: The device has too many pending transfers.
errorProtocol: The transfer protocol was not understood. Both devices must use the new version.
